description: Cancel the business's plan when the owner asks to. The plan stays on until the end of the paid period (or trial) and is never charged again; a past-due plan ends now. Pass undo=true to keep a plan whose cancel has not taken effect yet. Requires the current owner role. Confirm with the owner before calling.

business_id.description: Business ID (optional only when the token can access exactly one business).

reason.description: Why the owner is cancelling, if they said.

undo.description: true keeps the plan: undoes a cancel that has not taken effect yet.

name: cancel_subscription
title: Cancel Subscription
